question: The ‘Digital Population Clock’ was inaugurated at the ________ in September 2021.

options.text: National Institute of Educational Planning and Administration, New Delhi

solution:
The correct answer is__** Institute of Economic Growth, Delhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Digital Population Clock"** was launched by** Bharati Pravin Pawar,** Union Minister of State for Health & Family Welfare.
 
• It was launched on September 10, 2021.
 
• Digital Population Clock was inaugurated at the **Institute for Economic Growth at the University of Delhi**.
 
• On the occasion, she also launched the book** "Infant and Child Mortality in Assam - Demographic and Socio-Economic Interrelations."**
 
• **Dr. Dipanjali Haloi and Dr. Suresh Sharma** wrote the book.
 
• **A HMIS Brochure, or Ready Reckoner,** was also issued at the occasion.
 
• In order to provide a **minute-by-minute **estimate of **India's population,** the population clock was launched.
 
• Data on the rates of **total fertility, infant mortality, and maternal mortality** will be collected.
 
• It will aid in **conducting research **and **educating the next generatio**n. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** "Paalan 1000 National Campaign"** was launched on **August 16, 2022.**
 
• **Bharati Pravin Pawar**, the Union Minister of State for Health, gave it a** virtual launch.**
 
• Compared to** 2014**, when it was **45 per 1000 live birth**s, **child mortality **has **decreased to 35 per 1000 live** births in **2019.**
 
• This initiative was started because a **child's physical, emotional, mental, cognitive, and social health** are all strongly influenced by their first **1000 days.**
 
• The "Paalan 1000 Journey of the First 1000 Days" also offers early **years training for parents, caregivers, and families.**
